verdict.rationale: Canva's developer docs do name its plan tiers (Pro, Business, Enterprise) and gate specific features by tier, such as MCP AI-connector tools at 'Pro and above' and private apps at Enterprise only. That gives some first-party clarity on tiers and feature gating, but nothing in the pack shows a published pricing page. Missing for 10: published prices per tier, seat-type definitions, a full AI-feature gating matrix, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, published plan pricing makes seat types, tiers, and AI-feature gating clear before procurement

citations.quote: **Pro and above:** Feature is available to Canva Pro, Business, and Enterprise plans
Private apps are only available to [teams](https://www.canva.com/for-teams/) on an [Enterprise plan](https://www.canva.com/enterprise/).
